title: Access Paths for Efficient Ordering with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.00303v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we present the \texttt{LLM ORDER BY} semantic operator as a logical abstraction and conduct a systematic study of its physical implementations. First, we propose several improvements to existing semantic sorting algorithms and introduce a semantic-aware external merge sort algorithm. Our extensive evaluation reveals that no single implementation offers universal optimality on all datasets. From our evaluations, we observe a general scaling relationship between sorting cost and the ordering quality for comparison-based algorithms. Building on these insights, we design a budget-aware optimizer that utilizes heuristic rules, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, and consensus aggregation to dynamically select the near-optimal access path for LLM ORDER BY. translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 \texttt{LLM ORDER BY} 语义算子作为一种逻辑抽象，并对其物理实现进行了系统性研究。首先，我们对现有的语义排序算法提出了若干改进，并引入了一种语义感知的外部归并排序算法。我们的大量评估表明，没有任何单一实现在所有数据集上都能达到普遍最优。从评估中，我们观察到基于比较的算法在排序成本与排序质量之间存在普遍的扩展关系。基于这些洞察，我们设计了一个预算感知的优化器，该优化器利用启发式规则、LLM-as-Judge 评估和共识聚合来动态选择 LLM ORDER BY 的近优访问路径。在我们的大量评估中，我们的优化器在所有基准测试中始终实现了与最佳静态方法相当或更优的排序准确率。我们相信，这
tldr: 提出了LLM ORDER BY语义算子及预算感知优化器，通过动态选择近优访问路径，在所有基准测试中实现了与最佳静态方法相当或更优的排序准确率。
en_tdlr: We propose the LLM ORDER BY semantic operator and a budget-aware optimizer that dynamically selects near-optimal access paths, consistently achieving ranking accuracy on par with or superior to the best static methods across all benchmarks.
